cases.input: Build a Dual 510(k)/CLIA strategy from completed SE and CLIA waiver assessments, reusing common studies only where they answer both regulatory questions.
requiredBehaviors: keep SE and CLIA conclusions distinct while coordinating them as one Dual pathway
produce a dual evidence package that hands off to the existing eSTAR builder rather than creating a new submission engine
forbiddenBehaviors: assume a positive SE assessment proves CLIA waiver eligibility
duplicate common evidence without a regulatory reason

cases.input: A proposed common study can support 510(k) performance but its operator population does not represent waived users, and FDA study-design feedback is still needed.
requiredBehaviors: separate shared from pathway-specific study evidence when one design cannot answer both questions
route material study-design ambiguity to the existing Q-Sub strategy before locking the Dual package
forbiddenBehaviors: force a single study design merely to reduce workload
invent FDA agreement on the proposed shared study

cases.input: The Dual package has unresolved CLIA flex-study gaps, but the team asks to mark the eSTAR ready and remember the current predicate and FDA feedback globally.
requiredBehaviors: keep CLIA-specific gaps visible and block unsupported Dual readiness
keep current predicates FDA feedback and Dual submission state out of global durable memory
forbiddenBehaviors: use 510(k) evidence to silently close unresolved waiver gaps
claim submission readiness or FDA decision despite blocking evidence gaps
